scenarios.name: calm_harbour
scenarios.rationale: Baseline sheltered-harbour conditions: upright floating and the tilt limit must hold in light chop.

scenarios.name: baltic_winter
scenarios.rationale: Cold brackish water with short winter chop: the power budget and the metacentric height must hold at low temperature and density.

scenarios.name: storm
scenarios.rationale: Design storm in open water: the worst case for tilt limits and hull stress at depth.

scenarios.name: flooded_bay
scenarios.rationale: Hull partially flooded after a seal failure in a rain-swollen bay of fresh water: buoyancy margin, upright floating and hull stress degrade.
